notes.title: Hello Sunshine coming to Tokyo Game Show
notes.content: [h3]Say "Hello" to "Sunshine" at Tokyo Game Show next week![/h3][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537926/c7bd51fe3398f1f3bbd11ebd2032618d80f82668.png"][/img][/h2][p]On September 25, Hello Sunshine is making its [b]first public appearance[/b] in Tokyo, where players will have an opportunity to play a demo of our upcoming mystery survival RPG — solo and co-op.[/p][p]The Hello Sunshine booth is located at Makuhari Messe, Main Hall 5, booth 05-N08 — in collaboration with the Norwegian Film Institute and [url="https://www.nfi.no/en/festivals/tokyo-game-show-2025"]several amazing Norwegian games[/url].[/p][p]After a very long radio silence, we're finally ready to share a (small) piece of the world we’re building — and we can’t wait to see what you think.[/p][p]If you're heading to TGS, please come find us and be among the first in the world to play Hello Sunshine![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537926/83ca2412031ce4ffda96197c508c7f608b51a683.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]If Japan isn’t in your travel plans, don’t worry! There’s plenty more Hello Sunshine news on the horizon. Follow along on Steam, and join [u][url="http://redthreadgames.com/discord"]our Discord[/url][/u] for exclusive updates.[/p][p]We hope to see you there![/p][p]Team Red Thread[/p][p][i]P.S. Make sure to [u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3245140/Hello_Sunshine/"]wishlist[/url][/u] if you haven’t already![/i][/p]
